newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT -Dollar on shaky ground through Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Dollar on shaky ground through Tuesday.

text.p: *Dlr volatility seen through Tues due to upcoming Japan's July trade data, Bundesbank repo rate news, Federal Reserve meeting *Dlr/mark temporary bottom at 1.8155, Fri low. No real support before 1.8050. Upside seen capped at 1.83. Mark/yen a negative *Dlr/yen firmer, needs to retake 118.70, Fri high, for retest of 119.58, Aug 6 high. Strong prop at 116.55 for go at 121.00. *Mark/yen bullish ahead of 65.00 test, rally to top out at 66.
